name: the-weight-of-compassion
description: 30-second vertical animated short film built with Remotion

scripts.assets: python3 scripts/make_timeline.py && python3 scripts/make_textures.py && python3 scripts/make_audio.py
scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts WeightOfCompassion out/raw.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --browser-executable=/opt/pw-browsers/chromium && npm run finalize
scripts.finalize: ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/raw.mp4 -vf scale=in_range=full:out_range=tv,format=yuv420p -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 17 -pix_fmt yuv420p -color_range tv -colorspace bt709 -color_primaries bt709 -color_trc bt709 -c:a aac -b:a 192k -t 30 -movflags +faststart out/the-weight-of-compassion.mp4 && rm out/raw.mp4
